title: Solver FITS dimensions and BITPIX convert nonfinite values to int
summary: fits_card_value accepts strtod nan; dimension comparisons with NaN all evaluate false. BITPIX is cast before validating supported values. A current-source extracted header parser compiled with undefined/float-cast-overflow sanitizers accepts a valid 8x8 control, but NAXIS1=nan, BITPIX=nan and BITPIX=1e100 each abort at the conversion. Require finite integer header fields and validate BITPIX before conversion; reject malformed FITS without changing framework property validation.

resolution.evidence: 20261101200402-fcb2-fix-solver-fits-header/verification.md, security.md and quality-review.md: original characterization, scoped fix, full applicable regressions and independent review passed with documented platform/dependency limits.
